title: Focus
description: A timer for focus sessions and breaks. The time is kept on the server, so it continues from the same point on another device.

toast.focusDone: Focus session completed. Time for a break.
toast.activeElsewhere: A session is already running; showing that one.

week.title: Last 7 days
week.explain: Each bar shows the total length, without pauses, of the focus sessions completed that day, in minutes. Breaks and abandoned sessions are not counted.
week.caption: Minutes of focus and number of sessions on each of the last seven days

lengths.title: Timer lengths
lengths.description: Lengths are saved to your account and apply on all your devices.
lengths.longBreakEvery: Focus sessions before a long break
lengths.range: Enter a whole number between {{min}} and {{max}}.
